votes.motion: Approve an all-alcoholic retail package store license for Elena Christopher d/b/a Elena's Gourmet Grocery.
votes.quote: ms. bertram seconded the motion. on vote, motion carried 5 in favor, o opposed.

votes.motion: Appoint Todd Blake, Richard Cohen and Mike Barney to the School Building Committee as citizens-at-large.
votes.quote: it was decided to deal with that matter after this current appointment. ms. bertram seconded the motion. on vote, motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Nathan Lockwood (Planning Board), Mike Mackin (School Committee), Dave Matthews (Board of Selectmen) and Colleen Shapiro (School Committee) to the School Building Committee.
votes.quote: representing the school committee to the school building committee. ms. bertram seconded the motion. on vote, motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Appoint David Passios to the Board of Health.
votes.quote: ms. bertram made a motion to appoint david passios to the board of health. mr. debettencourt seconded the motion. on vote, motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Adopt the state-wide Public Safety Mutual Aid law (Mass GL c.40 s.4J) and the state-wide Public Works Mutual Aid law (Mass GL c.40 s.4K) as written.
votes.quote: mutual aid agreement. mr. sund seconded the motion. on vote, motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.
mr. debettencourt motioned to adjourn the meeting. ms. bertram seconded. all board members were in favor.

decisions.decision: Town Manager said the beer and wine license Elena's had held will be re-advertised.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel commented and said that they will re-advertise the beer and wine license which elena's had held.

decisions.decision: Per Town Counsel, Central Mass Power Sports (expired license) will be notified it is operating without a license; if it continues a criminal complaint will be filed. No revocation.
decisions.quote: the procedure will be to notify them that they are operating without a license and if it continues there will be a criminal complaint filed.

decisions.decision: Chair David Matthews signed a request letter asking for a MassDOT hearing to be held in Fitchburg.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel had a request letter prepared and mr. matthews signed it.

decisions.decision: Mr. Matthews requested that a different town-counsel attorney be assigned to handle matters like the Central Mass Power Sports license in future.
decisions.quote: mr. matthews requested that they are assigned a different attorney, from town counsel, to handle matters such as this in the future.
